question: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university
sql:
WITH rank_averages AS (
    SELECT FacRank, AVG(FacSalary) as avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
faculty_with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        f.FacRank,
        f.FacFirstName,
        f.FacLastName,
        f.FacSalary,
        ra.avg_salary,
        ABS(f.FacSalary - ra.avg_salary) as salary_diff
    FROM university_faculty f
    JOIN rank_averages ra ON f.FacRank = ra.FacRank
),
rank_min_diff AS (
    SELECT FacRank, MIN(salary_diff) as min_diff
    FROM faculty_with_diff
    GROUP BY FacRank
)
SELECT fd.FacRank, fd.FacFirstName, fd.FacLastName, fd.FacSalary, fd.avg_salary, fd.salary_diff
FROM faculty_with_diff fd
JOIN rank_min_diff rmd ON fd.salary_diff = rmd.min_diff
ORDER BY fd.FacRank, fd.salary_diff

WITH rank_averages AS (
    SELECT FacRank, AVG(FacSalary) as avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
faculty_with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        f.FacRank,
        f.FacFirstName,
        f.FacLastName,
        f.FacSalary,
        ra.avg_salary,
        ABS(f.FacSalary - ra.avg_salary) as salary_diff
    FROM university_faculty f
    JOIN rank_averages ra ON f.FacRank = ra.FacRank
),
rank_min_diff AS (
    SELECT FacRank, MIN(salary_diff) as min_diff
    FROM faculty_with_diff
    GROUP BY FacRank
)
SELECT fd.FacRank, fd.FacFirstName, fd.FacLastName, fd.FacSalary
FROM faculty_with_diff fd
JOIN rank_min_diff rmd ON fd.salary_diff = rmd.min_diff
ORDER BY fd.FacRank, fd.salary_diff
